help.title: Help
help.body:
## What this tab does

Micro-Otter graphs run on plain MicroPython: the Deploy tab uploads the deployed graph and its node libraries as `.py` source, so no firmware build is required to run a graph.

Precompiling the node libraries to `.mpy` and freezing them into the MicroPython firmware uses less user-area memory and starts faster. This tab builds and deploys that firmware.

To deploy a graph collection you only need a compatible firmware: you do not need to compile a new firmware for every graph change.

offline.body:
## Firmware server unavailable

The Firmware tab needs the local Micro-Otter server, which is not reachable right now.

### What the server adds

- Building and flashing firmware images
- Importing a package by path or URL
- Exporting a package into a folder you pick
- Installing add-on packages

### Start the server

```bash
uv run micro-otter serve
```

The editor's other tabs keep working while the server is down.
